reason: I travel a lot and always leave my pills at home, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is the first version of this that fits how I live. At the $24.99 launch price I'd try one box, but I wouldn't pay $29.99 on a first look.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. Also it's made in China, so I'd want to see that lab report actually matches the box before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the price stayed at $24.99 or lower after the launch window, I'd likely reorder; if it went to $29.99 with no other change, I'd skip it.
